title: JD Vance Praises Karoline Leavitt as She Announces Departure from Trump Administration
text:
Vice President JD Vance praised White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt for her grace and effectiveness in facing media criticism, as she announced her departure from the Trump administration to focus on her family.
Vice President JD Vance praised White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt after she announced she was stepping down. Leavitt faced constant criticism from the media while serving in one of the administration's toughest roles.
'Karoline Leavitt has one of the hardest jobs in the Administration - dealing with the relentless attacks from the fake news media,' Vance wrote. 'She did the job with grace, wit and a smile on her face. ' He said Leavitt had become one of the administration's most effective messengers and thanked her for her work. 'She's been one of the most effective voices in articulating and defending the President's agenda, and I'm incredibly grateful to her,' he said.
Vance said the administration was sorry to see Leavitt leave but predicted she would remain successful after her departure. Leavitt announced Wednesday that she will leave the Trump administration at the end of August to focus on her family, reflecting on her time as President Donald Trump's chief spokeswoman.
In a post on X, she thanked Trump for allowing her to serve in the White House and described her time as press secretary as the honor and adventure of a lifetime.
'I have spoken with great pride about the many historic accomplishments of this Administration, and I have relished holding the liberal media accountable,' she wrote. Leavitt served in the Trump administration for just over a year, having taken on the role in June 2023 after previously serving as a senior communications advisor. During her tenure, she became known for her sharp exchanges with reporters and her defense of Trump's policies
